_HOW_TO_USE: Replace every <ANGLE BRACKET> value, delete the _ fields, save as config.json. This is the ONLY file that changes between websites.

company._name: Exact brand name as it should appear in the byline and CTA.
company.name: <COMPANY NAME>
company._site: Homepage URL, no trailing slash. Used to build JSON-LD.
company._location: City, State. Use "" if they have no physical presence.
company._what_we_are: Finishes the sentence 'Write a blog post for [NAME], ___'. Include years in business if it's a credibility asset.
company.what_we_are: <a residential plumbing company / a B2B logistics firm / an orthodontic practice>
company._services: Comma-separated list of every service line. The model uses this to keep CTAs relevant.
company._audience: Who reads this, and whether coverage is local or national. Say it plainly.
company.audience: <US homeowners, national / small business owners in the Dallas metro>
company._reading_level: Sets vocabulary and assumed background knowledge.
company.reading_level: <a busy homeowner with no technical knowledge / an experienced facilities manager>
company._author_name: Byline. A named person with credentials beats a team name for E-E-A-T.
company.author_name: <The COMPANY Team / Jane Smith, Licensed Master Plumber>
company._author_bio: 2-3 sentences for the ABOUT THE AUTHOR box. Concrete credentials, not adjectives.
company._cta_url: Where the mid-article CTA points. Booking or contact page.
company._cta_label: The action phrase. 'Book a free consultation', 'Get a quote', 'Schedule a call'.
company._trusted_sources: Which organisations are authoritative in THIS field. Prevents the model citing content farms.
company.trusted_sources: <EPA, ASHRAE, ICC, or a .edu/.gov source relevant to the topic>
company._facts_to_respect: TWO JOBS: (1) domain facts the model must not get wrong, (2) explicit PROHIBITIONS on repeating unverified marketing claims, guarantees, or statistics from the client's own site. Do not skip part 2.
company.facts_to_respect: <Key domain facts.> Never repeat marketing claims, guarantees, or statistics about <COMPANY> -- describe the approach qualitatively instead.

article._model: claude-sonnet-5 is the sensible default. claude-opus-4-8 for better prose at ~3x cost.

discovery._min_volume: Ignore keywords below this monthly search volume. 100-150 is sensible.
discovery._max_kd: Ahrefs Keyword Difficulty ceiling. 25 for a new site, 35-40 once it ranks for things.
discovery._per_service: How many candidates to surface per service each week.
discovery._seeds: ONE broad seed keyword per service line. Ahrefs expands each into question-style ideas. Keep seeds short and generic -- 'water heater', not 'best tankless water heater 2026'.

_banned_phrases: AI-tell blocklist. Add anything overused in this specific industry.
banned_phrases: at the end of the day
